comment: What :html ships that is read as a resource, declared by glob rather than
Two stylesheets, in two packages, because this module carries two views:
getResourceAsStream through Stylesheet.resource, and neither was declared
They worked anyway, and that is the part worth writing down: the showcase
traces a run, the traced run opens the Markdown and HTML screens, and the
trace recorded them. That is luck, and it is exactly the luck ADR-0160 says
not to build on -- an application that takes :html and builds an image
without tracing one of those screens got a module whose stylesheet is not
in the image, and the first document it renders throws. The emoji face in
the sibling module is the same defect with the luck running the other way.
Two entries rather than one glob over the module root: `**` would match
every .class file as a resource and carry the module twice, which is the
reason :core's metadata gives for spelling its paths out.
